user.title: Add EasyControlX host
user.description: Connect to an EasyControlX host. If you already have a token, paste it here. Otherwise leave the token blank and the integration will start pairing through the host approval flow.

pair.title: Approve pairing

reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this EasyControlX host.
